user.title: Add Timer 24H
user.description: Configure your 24-hour timer with automatic entity control

data_description.name: Give your timer a descriptive name
data_description.entities: Select entities that will be automatically controlled by this timer
data_description.home_sensors: Select sensors/entities that determine when timer should activate (e.g., home presence, Shabbat mode, vacation mode, temperature). Leave empty to always activate.
data_description.home_logic: OR: Timer activates if ANY condition is met. AND: Timer activates only if ALL conditions are met.

toggle_slot.name: Toggle Time Slot
toggle_slot.description: Toggles a specific time slot on or off for the 24-hour timer.

hour.name: Hour
hour.description: The hour of the time slot (0-23).

minute.name: Minute
minute.description: The minute of the time slot (0 or 30).

set_slots.name: Set Time Slots
set_slots.description: Sets multiple time slots at once for the 24-hour timer.
